objective: Enforce MAX_REGION_PARTS as a total payload cap in assembleRegion and add near-limit regression tests without changing public contracts.

context.content: Implement the next ready goal: ensure assembleRegion returns no more than MAX_REGION_PARTS total focus plus context parts, and add deterministic regression tests for primed-neighbor regional assembly with 40, 50, and 55 focus items.

constraints: Preserve MAX_REGION_PARTS = 60 and existing focus-before-context ordering.
Count focus and context together against the 60-part maximum.
Keep context deduplicated and never replace focus parts with context.
Do not modify package files, documentation, generated assets, or .mozak artifacts.
Do not use network access or add dependencies.
Run exactly: npm test -- --run, npm run typecheck, npm run build.
Do not claim success unless every acceptance condition has observed evidence.

acceptance_conditions.behavior: assembleRegion returns at most 60 total parts for isolated, related, and regional detail.
acceptance_conditions.required_evidence: Automated assertions over payload.parts.length including regional 40/50/55 focus cases.

acceptance_conditions.behavior: Regional assembly with primed neighbors returns exactly 60 total parts for 40, 50, and 55 focus items, retaining all focus items and filling only remaining capacity with context.
acceptance_conditions.required_evidence: Regression test observations of total, focus, and context counts for each case.

acceptance_conditions.behavior: Only src/region.ts and test/resolver.test.ts change from the packet baseline.
